description:
Who it is for

Business founders and investors with a foreign-owned company (PT PMA) in Indonesia, whose shares meet the current minimum. Ask us about your case.

What we need from you

  • Your passport Valid for at least 12 more months.
  • A recent photo of you A colour passport-style photo.
  • Your sponsor company’s legal documents From your PT PMA in Indonesia.
  • Anything else Some cases need more documents. We tell you which ones when you chat with us.

What the price includes

  • The application documents Prepared by our team.
  • The government fee (PNBP) Paid by us as part of the application.
  • Anything else Depends on your case. Ask us and we explain the full price.

How it works

  1. Chat with us Tell us about your plans, in English or Russian, on WhatsApp or Telegram.
  2. We check your documents Send us what the visa needs. We confirm it fits before you pay.
  3. Pay online Once we confirm the visa fits, you pay on our website.
  4. Receive your visa We apply for you and keep you updated until your e-Visa or Stay Permit letter arrives.

Good to know

How much capital do I need?

Under the latest immigration and BKPM rules, your name must be in the PT PMA’s deed with personal shares worth at least Rp 10,000,000,000 (10 billion rupiah), and the company’s issued capital must also be at least Rp 10 billion.

Can I extend it after 2 years without leaving Indonesia?

Yes. Before your 2 years end, we can process the extension inside Indonesia.

Who it is for

Foreigners aged 55 or over with a steady pension or passive income, who do not plan to work in Indonesia.

What we need from you

  • Your passport Valid for at least 12 more months.
  • A recent photo of you A colour passport-style photo.
  • Proof of pension or passive income A pension fund or regular income from outside Indonesia.
  • Your rental agreement For the place you will live in Indonesia.
  • Anything else Some cases need more documents. We tell you which ones when you chat with us.

What the price includes

  • The application documents Prepared by our team.
  • The government fee (PNBP) Paid by us as part of the application.
  • Flexible scheduling We book your biometrics and photo at the immigration office at a time that suits you.
  • VIP accompaniment A member of our team is with you at the immigration office.

How it works

  1. Chat with us Tell us about your plans, in English or Russian, on WhatsApp or Telegram.
  2. We check your documents Send us what the visa needs. We confirm it fits before you pay.
  3. Pay online Once we confirm the visa fits, you pay on our website.
  4. Receive your visa We apply for you and keep you updated until your e-Visa or Stay Permit letter arrives.

Good to know

Can I work or open a business with a retirement KITAS?

No, not at all.

What does “offshore” mean? Do I have to come to Indonesia first?

No. Offshore means we process all your documents while you are still abroad.

Can I extend it without leaving Indonesia?

Yes. Before your year ends, we can process the extension inside Indonesia.

Who it is for

Foreigners who work for a company outside Indonesia and want to live in Bali for a year. The permit lets you stay and bring your family with you.

What we need from you

  • Your passport Valid for at least 6 more months.
  • A photo of you A clear photo of the passport holder.
  • Proof of income A statement from your company (salary form) or your bank account, showing an income of at least US$60,000 a year.

What the price includes

  • The e-visa Prepared and submitted by our team in Balangan.
  • Sponsorship We act as your sponsor for the application.
  • The government e-visa fee Paid by us as part of the application.

How it works

  1. Chat with us Tell us about your plans, in English or Russian, on WhatsApp or Telegram.
  2. We check your documents Send us what the visa needs. We confirm it fits before you pay.
  3. Pay online Once we confirm the visa fits, you pay on our website.
  4. Receive your visa We apply for you and keep you updated until your e-Visa or Stay Permit letter arrives.

Good to know

Can I bring my family?

Yes, the E33G lets your family come with you. Ask us what each family member needs and what it costs.

Can I work for an Indonesian company with it?

No. The E33G is for people whose employer or clients are outside Indonesia.

Why can't I pay online straight away?

A KITAS depends on your documents. We check them with you first, so you never pay for a permit you cannot get.

Who it is for

The legal spouse, or a child under 18, of a KITAS or KITAP holder. The foreign spouse of an Indonesian citizen, and children of a mixed Indonesian–foreign marriage.

What we need from you

  • Your passport Valid for at least 12 more months.
  • A recent photo of you A colour passport-style photo.
  • Your marriage certificate For a spouse.
  • A birth certificate For a child.
  • Anything else Some cases need more documents. We tell you which ones when you chat with us.

  4. Receive your visa We apply for you and keep you updated until your e-Visa or Stay Permit letter arrives.

Good to know

How long is the Family KITAS valid?

A full year (12 months) from the day your family arrives in Indonesia. It can be extended every year without leaving Indonesia.

Can a Family KITAS holder work in Indonesia?

No. Working or earning money in Indonesia is not allowed.

Who it is for

Holders of an active, valid E33G remote-worker ITAS. Apply at least 30 days before it expires.

What we need from you

  • Your passport Valid for at least 12 more months.
  • A recent photo of you A colour passport-style photo.
  • Your active e-stay permit or ITAS The E33G you are staying on now.
  • You must be in Indonesia The application is made while you are in the country.
  • Proof of income At least US$60,000 a year, or US$5,000 a month.
  • Your employment contract With a company outside Indonesia.

When is the best time to apply?

30 days before your KITAS expires is the safest time.

Is the government fee (PNBP) included?

Yes. Our price is all-in.

Who it is for

Holders of a retirement KITAS, usually aged 55 or over.

What we need from you

  • Your passport Valid for at least 12 more months; more than 24 months is better.
  • A recent photo of you A colour passport-style photo.
  • Your current e-stay permit or ITAS The retirement KITAS you are staying on now.

How many times can I extend?

Up to four times, one year at a time.

Who it is for

Foreign spouses and children of a KITAS or KITAP holder (an investor, for example) or of an Indonesian citizen. The permit follows the sponsor’s own permit, or you choose a stay of 1 or 2 years.

What we need from you

  • Your passport Valid for at least 12 more months; more than 24 months is better.
  • A recent photo of you A colour passport-style photo.
  • Your current e-stay permit or visa The family permit you are staying on now.
  • A letter from your Indonesian spouse If your spouse is Indonesian: their request letter for your visa.
  • You must be in Indonesia The application is made while you are in the country.

Only foreigners who are already inside Indonesia.

What we need from you

  • Your passport Valid for at least 6 more months, or 12 months if you travel on a document other than a national passport.
  • A recent photo of you A colour passport-style photo.
  • Your current e-stay permit Still active, with at least 7 days left before it expires.

What the price includes

  4. Receive your visa We apply for you and keep you updated until your e-Visa or Stay Permit letter arrives.

Good to know

What happens if I leave Indonesia?

The bridging visa ends. It is only valid while you stay in the country.

Can I extend a bridging visa?

No. It cannot be extended.

Who it is for

Foreigners coming to Indonesia for business meetings as well as tourism.

What we need from you

  • Your passport Valid for at least 6 more months. Send a good-quality photo of it.
  • A photo of you A photo of the passport holder; a phone photo is fine.

What the price includes

  • The D2 e-visa Prepared and submitted by our team in Balangan.
  • Sponsorship We act as your sponsor for the application.
  • The government e-visa fee Paid by us as part of the application.

How it works

  1. Chat with us Tell us about your plans, in English or Russian, on WhatsApp or Telegram.
  2. We check your documents Send us what the visa needs. We confirm it fits before you pay.
  3. Pay online Once we confirm the visa fits, you pay on our website.
  4. Receive your visa We apply for you and keep you updated until your e-Visa or Stay Permit letter arrives.

Good to know

Do I need to visit an embassy?

No. Once the e-visa is ready you can use it directly.

Can I stay longer than 60 days?

Yes, twice, 60 days at a time, up to 180 days in total. We handle the D2 extension too.

Who it is for

Foreigners coming to Indonesia for business visits that are not operational work. Every nationality except the countries on Indonesia’s calling-visa list: we cannot help citizens of Afghanistan, Israel, North Korea, Liberia, Nigeria or Somalia yet.

What we need from you

  • Your passport Valid for at least 6 more months, or 12 months if you travel on a document other than a national passport.
  • A recent photo of you A colour passport-style photo.

What the price includes

  • The application documents Prepared by our team.
  • The government fee (PNBP) Paid by us as part of the application.

How it works

  1. Chat with us Tell us about your plans, in English or Russian, on WhatsApp or Telegram.
  2. We check your documents Send us what the visa needs. We confirm it fits before you pay.
  3. Pay online Once we confirm the visa fits, you pay on our website.
  4. Receive your visa We apply for you and keep you updated until your e-Visa or Stay Permit letter arrives.

Good to know

Can I extend the C2?

Yes, twice, up to 180 days in total. We can handle the extension for you too.

Can I work for an Indonesian company with a C2?

No, not at all. The C2 is only for business visits, not for operational work.
